principiante.objetivo: Build an aerobic base without getting injured.
principiante.calentamiento: 5-8 min walking or very easy jogging.
principiante.enfriamiento: 5 min easy walking + calf, quad and hamstring stretches (20-30s each).

bloques.detalle: 20-25 min at a comfortable pace (you can talk without gasping). If walking, brisk pace.
6 x (3 min easy jog + 2 min walking), ~30 min total. Ideal if running continuously is still hard.

intermedio.objetivo: Improve endurance and start tolerating some intensity.
intermedio.enfriamiento: 5-8 min easy jog + full lower-body stretches.

bloques.detalle: 6 x 3 min at moderate-high pace, with 90s easy jog recovery between each.
One weekly session should be a long, easy 35-45 min run.
25-30 min alternating pace by feel: speed up to the next lamppost/tree, recover jogging to the next landmark.
4 x 80m high knees/butt kicks/wide strides, walking back.

avanzado.objetivo: Work on threshold and speed to lower your times.
avanzado.calentamiento: 10-12 min progressive + dynamic hip and ankle mobility.
avanzado.enfriamiento: 10 min easy jog + stretches + foam roller if you have one.

bloques.detalle: 5 x 5 min at "comfortably hard" (threshold) pace, 2 min jog between reps.
One weekly session of 60-75 min at an easy-moderate pace.
8-10 x 45s hard uphill, jogging back down to recover.
8 x 1 min hard (a bit faster than 5k pace), 1 min jog recovery.
20 min starting easy and speeding up every 5 min to finish hard.

profesional.calentamiento: 15 min progressive + specific activation (high knees, butt kicks, lateral strides).
profesional.enfriamiento: 15 min easy jog + full mobility + ice/recovery if there's any soreness.

bloques.detalle: 10-12 x 400m at target race pace, 200m jog recovery.
90 min with the last 20 min at threshold pace.
1-2 gym sessions/week: squats, lunges, core, light plyometrics.
4 x 2000m at threshold pace, 3 min jog recovery.
Easy 30 min run in the morning + quality session in the afternoon, if your schedule allows.

principiante.objetivo: Adapt to the movement and build an aerobic base.
principiante.calentamiento: 5 min at a very easy pace, low resistance.
principiante.enfriamiento: 5 min minimal resistance + quad, hamstring and calf stretches.

bloques.detalle: 20 min at a steady pace, low-medium resistance, comfortable cadence (~70-80 rpm if cycling).
4 x (3 min low resistance + 2 min medium resistance), without tiring yourself out.
6 x 3 min medium-high resistance, 2 min easy recovery between each.
1-2-3-4-3-2-1 min at high intensity, with half the time as easy recovery between each segment.
4 x 8 min at sustained high intensity, 3 min active recovery between intervals.
8 x 20s as hard as you can, 100s recovery.
6 x 4 min at very high cadence (100+ rpm) with moderate resistance, 2 min recovery.

profesional.enfriamiento: 15 min very easy + hip and lower back mobility.

bloques.detalle: 3 x 12-15 min at functional threshold pace, 5 min recovery.
10 x 30s max sprint, 4 min full recovery.
60-75 min continuous, varying intensity by feel, simulating a real event.

principiante.objetivo: Improve technique and last longer without exhausting yourself.
principiante.enfriamiento: 100m very easy + shoulder and back stretches.

bloques.detalle: 8 x 25m with 20s rest, focused on technique rather than speed.
300-400m without stopping at a very comfortable pace, pausing to rest if needed.

intermedio.objetivo: Increase volume and add some pace.
intermedio.enfriamiento: 150m easy + shoulder, back and hip stretches.

bloques.detalle: 8 x 50m at moderate-high pace, 20-30s rest between reps.
600-800m continuous at a steady, comfortable pace.

avanzado.objetivo: Work on specific threshold and speed.
avanzado.calentamiento: 300m easy + technical drills with paddles or pull-buoy if available.

bloques.detalle: 6 x 100m at a strong, sustained pace, 20s rest.
8 x 25m at max speed, full rest (45-60s).
5 x 200m at a steady, demanding pace, 30s rest between intervals.
10 x 100m at race pace, 15-20s rest.
6 x 25m max effort, full rest.
2 gym sessions/week: pull-ups, rowing, core.
6 x 400m at target long-event pace, 30s rest.

principiante.objetivo: Learn the basic movements with good technique.
principiante.calentamiento: 5 min easy cardio + general joint mobility.

bloques.detalle: 3 sets x 12 reps, 60s rest
3 sets x 8-10 reps, 60s rest

bloques.nombre: Row with band or light dumbbell
bloques.detalle: 3 sets x 12 reps, 60s rest
3 sets x 20-30s, 45s rest
3 sets x 10 per leg, 60s rest
3 sets x 10 reps, 60s rest
3 sets x 15 reps, 45s rest
3 sets x 12 reps, 45s rest

intermedio.objetivo: Gain real strength with progressive loads.
intermedio.calentamiento: 8 min cardio + mobility + light warm-up sets.

bloques.detalle: 4 sets x 8-10 reps, 90s rest
4 sets x 8-10 reps, 90s rest
3 sets x 10 reps, 90s rest
3 sets x 8 reps, 90s rest
3 sets x 45s / 12 reps
4 sets x 6-8 reps, 2 min rest
3 sets x 10 per arm, 90s rest
3 sets x 10 per leg, 90s rest
3 sets x 15 reps, 60s rest

avanzado.calentamiento: 10 min + warm-up sets approaching working weight.

bloques.nombre: Main lift (squat, press, deadlift — rotating by session)
bloques.detalle: 5 sets x 5 reps at 80-85% of your max, 2-3 min rest
3-4 exercises x 3 sets x 10-12 reps, 60-90s rest
8 x 30s max effort / 30s rest (burpees, kettlebell swings, etc.)
4 sets x 8 reps, 2 min rest
4 sets x 8 reps, 2 min rest
3 sets x 10 per leg, 90s rest
3 sets x 12 per side
6 sets x 3 reps at 88-92% of your max, 3-4 min rest
15-20 min AMRAP combining gymnastic movements, loads and cardio, adjusted to your 1RM level
Specific movements based on your progress (shoulder mobility, olympic technique, etc.)
6 sets x 2-3 reps, technique prioritized over load, 3 min rest
5 sets x 5 box jumps, full 2 min rest
Circuit of 3 exercises x 3 rounds, 45s work/15s rest

principiante.objetivo: Learn basic poses, improve breathing and general mobility.
principiante.calentamiento: 5 min mindful breathing + gentle joint mobility.

bloques.detalle: Fundamental poses (cat-cow, downward dog, warrior I, child's pose), 3-5 breaths each.

variantes.nombre: Session B — hip and back mobility

bloques.detalle: Pigeon pose, butterfly and low lunge, 5 breaths each side.
Gentle lying twist + cat-cow repeated 8-10 times.
Linked sequence of 12-15 poses with fluid transitions, including basic balances (tree, warrior III).
Pilates hundred, leg raises and side plank, 3 rounds.
Chair pose and warrior II held, 5 breaths each.

avanzado.objetivo: More demanding poses and fine body control.

bloques.detalle: Includes assisted inversions (headstand against wall), arm balances, deep spinal flexions.
15 min of deep abdominal control and hip stability.
Pigeon variations and assisted splits, held 8-10 breaths.
Bridge and camel, 3-4 held reps.

profesional.objetivo: Technical mastery and sustained advanced practice.

bloques.detalle: 60-75 min practice combining strength, balance, deep flexibility and full inversions (free headstand, scorpion).

variantes.nombre: Session B — martial art of control (advanced pilates)

bloques.detalle: Advanced pilates sequence: teaser, leg circles, corkscrew, 3 full rounds.
Unsupported headstand and handstand, with progressions if not yet mastered.

principiante.objetivo: Learn the basic steps and get a feel for rhythm.
principiante.calentamiento: 5 min joint mobility and easy marching with music.

bloques.detalle: Repeating 2-3 fundamental steps of the chosen style, 20-25 min at a comfortable pace.
20 min dancing freely following the music's rhythm, no fixed choreography — just letting go.
Learn and repeat a 30-45 second sequence, 25-30 min of active practice.
Shoulder, hip and chest work separately, 15 min.
Linking 2 previously learned short sequences, 15 min.

avanzado.objetivo: Endurance and precision in full choreographies.

bloques.detalle: 2-3 minute sequence repeated several times at high intensity, 35-40 min.
4 x (full choreography + 1 min rest), increasing intensity each time.

profesional.calentamiento: 15-20 min of specific activation and technique.

bloques.detalle: Repeating full choreography at performance intensity, with technical corrections, 60-75 min.
2 sessions/week of dance-specific strength and endurance.
Detailed work in front of a mirror or video, correcting specific weak points, 40 min.
Full choreography once, at maximum demand, as if it were the real day.

principiante.objetivo: Improve basic technique and general fitness.
principiante.calentamiento: 8 min easy jog + ankle, hip and shoulder mobility.

variantes.nombre: Session A — technique and free play

bloques.detalle: 15-20 min repeating basic movements (pass/shot/hit depending on sport) at a comfortable pace.
15-20 min of easy practice or a friendly match.
15 min of basic control exercises (touches, wall drills, gentle rallying).
10-15 min of gentle lateral movements and direction changes, without a ball.

intermedio.objetivo: Improve specific endurance and technical consistency.

bloques.detalle: 4 stations of 5 min rotating between technique, reaction and movement.
20-30 min of play at real intensity.
8 x 1 min of intense action (sprints with direction changes and technical movement), 1 min rest.
15 min repeating the main technical movement (shot, hit, finish) aiming for precision, not just power.

avanzado.calentamiento: 12-15 min with neuromuscular activation and direction changes.

bloques.detalle: 20 min of specific game situations at high intensity.
1-2 sessions/week: lower-body strength, core and ankle/knee work.

variantes.nombre: Session B — specific speed and power

bloques.detalle: 10 x 20m with a direction change at 10m, full rest.
4 sets x 8 reps of the main technical movement with maximum power intent.
30-40 min of high-demand technical-tactical work.
2-3 sessions/week of sport-specific strength, speed and power.
30 min of specific work on weaknesses detected on video or by your coach.
Simulating the most demanding moments of a real match, repeated 4-5 times with full rest.

principiante.objetivo: Learn the basic swing and gain contact consistency.
principiante.calentamiento: 10 easy swings without a ball + shoulder and hip mobility.

bloques.detalle: 30-40 balls on the range focused on clean contact, short iron.
15 min practicing short putts.
20 min of short shots from the edge of the green, aiming for consistency.
20-25 balls focused on smooth tempo, not distance.

intermedio.objetivo: Improve consistency and start working different clubs.
intermedio.enfriamiento: Back, shoulder and hip stretches, 8 min.

bloques.detalle: 50-60 balls alternating irons and woods, working on trajectory.
20 min of short shots from different distances.
9 holes focused on course management, not just the score.
15 min simulating putts you "have to make".

avanzado.calentamiento: 20 min full warm-up with all clubs.
avanzado.duracion_total: 2-4 hours depending on whether it includes a round

bloques.detalle: 80-100 balls with specific distance targets.
30 min of approach, bunker and putting under pressure (bets with yourself).
9-18 holes focused on round management, not just the shot.
30 balls working controlled trajectories left-to-right and vice versa.
20 min practicing from rough, slopes or sand.

profesional.calentamiento: 25-30 min with swing analysis (video if possible).

bloques.detalle: 100+ balls with specific work on detected flaws.
Full round counting every shot as if it were a tournament.
2-3 sessions/week of rotational strength, core and mobility.
Repeating the exact same routine before each shot for 50 balls, to automate it.
9-18 holes playing against your own historic best per hole.

principiante.objetivo: Gain balance and basic speed control.
principiante.frecuencia: Seasonal sessions / 2-3 times/week on-slope or dryland
principiante.calentamiento: 10 min ankle, knee and hip mobility + gentle squats.

bloques.detalle: Practice braking, wide turns and balance on a gentle slope, 40-50 min.
4 sets x 30-45s per leg, if you don't have slope access.
3 sets x 30-40s holding the position, simulating ski/snowboard stance.

intermedio.objetivo: Improve turns and control on varied slopes.
intermedio.calentamiento: 12 min with dynamic squats and hip mobility.

bloques.detalle: Practice on medium-difficulty slopes, linking turns with speed control, 60 min.
Repeat short segments focused only on braking and starting off in a controlled way, 30 min.
30 min trying different slope angles within your comfortable level.

avanzado.objetivo: More demanding terrain and advanced technique.
avanzado.frecuencia: Depending on season, complemented with off-season physical prep
avanzado.enfriamiento: Stretches + knee and ankle mobility, 10 min.

bloques.detalle: Red/black runs or basic freestyle depending on discipline, 90 min.
2 sessions/week of leg strength, core and balance (bosu, single leg).
45 min focused on small turn radius and fine edge control.
3 sets x 8 slow Bulgarian split squats on the way down, to protect the knees.

profesional.frecuencia: Daily training in season + year-round physical prep
profesional.enfriamiento: Active recovery + preventive physiotherapy if applicable.

bloques.detalle: Discipline-specific work (slalom, jumps, tricks) based on level.
3-4 sessions/week of explosive strength, plyometrics and core.
Repeat the competition course or sequence several times at maximum demand, with full rest between reps.

principiante.objetivo: Learn basic technique and progressively gain grip strength.
principiante.calentamiento: 10 min finger, wrist and shoulder mobility + easy warm-up routes.
principiante.enfriamiento: Forearm, shoulder and finger stretches, 8 min.

bloques.detalle: 6-8 low-difficulty routes focused on footwork and balance, not just arms.
Climb 3-4 easy routes using only small footholds, to improve precision.
Practice keeping your hips close to the wall on lateral movements.

intermedio.objetivo: Gain specific strength and route endurance.
intermedio.enfriamiento: Forearm and shoulder stretches + finger decompression, 10 min.

bloques.detalle: Repeated attempts on 2-3 routes slightly above your comfortable level.
Continuous circuit of linked easy routes, 15-20 min without stopping.
4-5 medium-difficulty boulder problems, with full rest between attempts.
3 sets x 12 reverse wrist curls or similar, to protect the tendons.

avanzado.objetivo: Maximum finger strength and complex technical movements.
avanzado.calentamiento: 20 min full warm-up with progressive routes.
avanzado.enfriamiento: Full stretches + finger care (ice if sore), 10 min.

bloques.detalle: Training board exercises (fingers, strength blocks), 20-30 min.
Focused attempts on a route at the limit of your ability.
5-6 short problems with explosive movements, full rest between attempts.
Front lever progressions or hanging leg raises, 3 sets.

profesional.calentamiento: 25-30 min with specific finger and shoulder activation.
profesional.enfriamiento: Finger and shoulder recovery + full mobility, 15 min.

variantes.nombre: Session A — max strength and competition

bloques.detalle: Specific sessions on board/campus board.
Gym or competition route simulation.
2-3 sessions/week of core, upper body and antagonists (push) to prevent shoulder injuries.
Link several routes of progressive difficulty with short rests, as in a real round.

principiante.objetivo: Learn the guard and basic punches.
principiante.calentamiento: 5 min jump rope + shoulder and hip mobility.

bloques.detalle: 4 rounds of 2 min working jab-cross on the bag or shadowboxing, 1 min rest between rounds.
10 min practicing guard position in front of a mirror.
3 rounds of 2 min of lateral and backward slips, without punching.
6 rounds of 3 min with 3-4 punch combinations, 1 min rest.
2 rounds of movement and slipping.
5 rounds of 2 min practicing combinations you haven't mastered yet, without a bag.
3 rounds of push-ups, squats and crunches, 30s each exercise.
8-10 rounds of 3 min at fight intensity (heavy bag or mitts), 1 min rest.
Final core and leg power circuit, 10 min.
6 rounds of 3 min of guided combinations, 1 min rest.
3 sets x 15 punches with light wrist weights (if available), focused on speed.

profesional.enfriamiento: Active recovery + ice if needed, 15 min.

bloques.detalle: 8-12 rounds of 3 min with a partner, depending on training phase.
Boxing HIIT (bags, mitts, rope), 20-30 min.
2-3 sessions/week of explosive strength and rotational core.
Real number of rounds and rests for your category, at maximum intensity, with a partner or mitts.

principiante.objetivo: Learn to paddle and stand up consistently.
principiante.calentamiento: 10 min shoulder and back mobility + easy paddling.
principiante.enfriamiento: Shoulder, lower back and hamstring stretches, 8 min.

bloques.detalle: 45-60 min on small waves focused on the pop-up and balance.

variantes.nombre: Session B — dryland paddling and pop-up

bloques.detalle: 15-20 min paddling in a straight line to build endurance and stroke technique.
20 reps of jumping to standing position, without water, to automate the movement.

intermedio.objetivo: Catch green waves and improve paddling.

bloques.detalle: 60-90 min seeking medium-difficulty waves, working on basic turns.
30 min observing and paddling to the correct peak before trying to catch waves.
45 min focused on turning the board toward shore with more control.
90-120 min working specific maneuvers (cutback, bottom turn) on bigger waves.
2 sessions/week of shoulder/back strength and rotational core.
Full session in somewhat more demanding-than-usual conditions, prioritizing safety and strong paddling.

profesional.frecuencia: Depending on available waves + daily physical prep
profesional.enfriamiento: Active recovery + shoulder and back mobility, 15 min.

bloques.detalle: Seeking maximum-quality waves, competition maneuvers.
Explosive upper-body strength, core and specific cardiovascular endurance, 4-5 sessions/week.
20-30 min simulating a competition heat: best waves count, the rest are dropped.
20-25 min at a comfortable intensity, adapting the movement to your activity.
5 x (3 min activity + 2 min active rest), adapting the movement to what you practice.

intermedio.objetivo: Increase volume and add some variability.

bloques.detalle: 30-35 min combining moderate and high-intensity segments.
4 rounds of 3 different exercises/actions related to your activity, 40s work/20s rest.
40-50 min with well-defined high-intensity intervals.
50-60 min at moderate-sustained intensity, prioritizing volume over one-off intensity.
60-75 min of structured high-demand work, adjusted to your progress.
Simulation of your best recent performance, with full rest between max efforts.
